text: {"reconstruction":4,"feasibility":3,"rationale":"The proposal gets the right procedure and order (IMDb, then Rotten Tomatoes, then compose a mail with the same subject and body), but it has three problems: the recipient is not tied to {friend}@example.com, the body uses an undefined {name}, and the last step says \"Send or save\" when the true workflow says do not send and click Discard, so an automation built from it could send a real email."}

data.rationale: The proposal gets the right procedure and order (IMDb, then Rotten Tomatoes, then compose a mail with the same subject and body), but it has three problems: the recipient is not tied to {friend}@example.com, the body uses an undefined {name}, and the last step says "Send or save" when the true workflow says do not send and click Discard, so an automation built from it could send a real email.
